name: Ranger Elemental Maverick
body:
Elemental mavericks revel in scorching heat and frigid cold, and their enthusiasm for the extremes of nature are reflected in their magic.

An elemental maverick has the following class features.

Frost and Fire (Sp)

At 1st level, an elemental maverick can cast ray of frost and spark as spell-like abilities at will. For the purpose of this spell-like ability only, the elemental maverick’s caster level is equal to his extremist level.

This replaces wild empathy.

Combat Style Feat (Ex)

At 2nd level, an elemental maverick adds the magical combat style to his list of options from which to choose.

If the elemental maverick selects magical combat, he can choose from the following list whenever he gains a combat style feat: Combat Casting, Improved Initiative, Spell Focus, and Spell Penetration. At 6th level, he adds Greater Spell Penetration, Rime Spell, and Spell Specialization to the list. At 10th level, he adds Burning Spell (fire only), Selective Spell, and Minor Spell Expertise to the list.

This alters combat style.

Favored Spells (Ex)

At 3rd level, an elemental maverick is considered to be constantly under the effects of endure elements.

Furthermore, an elemental maverick adds all druid spells with the cold and fire descriptors to his spell list, and gains 1 extra spell per day for each level of spell he can cast.

When preparing this extra spell, an elemental maverick must prepare a spell with either the cold or fire descriptor.

Finally, an elemental maverick casts all spells with the cold or fire descriptor at +1 caster levels.

This alters spells and replaces all iterations of favored terrain.

Bonded Element (Ex)

At 4th level, an elemental maverick gains a third option from which to select for his hunter’s bond- he can select a bonded element. If he selects a bonded element, he must choose either cold or fire. (This choice is permanent and cannot be changed.) Whenever an elemental maverick deals damage from a weapon attack, he deals an additional +1d4 points of cold or fire damage (depending upon his selected element).

This alters hunter’s bond.

Elemental Resistance (Ex)

At 7th level, an elemental maverick selects either cold or fire and gains resistance 5 to that element. At 12th level, an elemental maverick again selects either cold or fire and gains resistance 10 to that element. At 17th level, an elemental maverick again selects either cold or fire and gains resistance 15 to that element. If the elemental maverick chooses the same element at multiple levels, the resistance stacks. For example, an elemental maverick that selects cold at all three levels would have cold resistance 30 by 17th level.

This replaces woodland stride, camouflage, and hide in plain sight.
